approval_evidence.quote: NDA 212728 NDA APPROVAL ... for rimegepant orally disintegrating tablets. This NDA provides for the use of Nurtec ODT (rimegepant) tablets for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults (electronically signed 02/27/2020)

series_start_reason: Pfizer completed the acquisition of Biohaven on Oct 3, 2022 and its 2022Q4 release is the first to print the line 'Nurtec ODT/Vydura' (the line includes Vydura, the ex-U.S. brand of rimegepant). Biohaven's own U.S. series for 2020Q1-2022Q2 is the companion series biohaven_nurtec_odt (different scope); 2022Q3 is in neither company's filings. (biohaven_nurtec_odt: Companion Series sheet, cited but not scored.)
search_log: listed filings of the issuer via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages), all forms incl. 8-K and 8-K/A (CIK 0000078003); Q4 2022 - Q2 2026 releases parsed for the Nurtec ODT/Vydura row
